A squadmate hitting a Scorched enemy triggers Afterburn (once per 1.5s): spends 8 Heat for Fire DMG equal to {0}% of her ATK plus Fire Anomaly Buildup. +1% Afterburn DMG per 10 Anomaly Proficiency (max +30%).
